Important (Must read): Since PopupWindow and Activity share the same Window, simple configuration achieves immersion. The key method is popupWindow.setClippingEnabled(false). On phones with a navigation bar, the bottom will be covered by the navigation bar (handled in demo). Also, if there is an input box at the bottom in immersion mode, the soft keyboard will cover it upon opening, even with soft input flags. If an input box exists at the bottom, use DialogFragment instead or do not enable immersion for PopupWindow.

In Compose pages, status bar and navigation bar can also be configured via ImmersionBar.

Toolbar and status bar are overlapping on this page. How to fix it?
No rush, let's first talk about the principle of immersion!
Principle: Immersion actually stretches the entire layout to fullscreen, which naturally makes the top of layout overlap with status bar.
Here are six solutions based on your project requirements (do not combine them):

(Not recommended, as status bar height varies per phone) Add a View tag above title bar, with height determined by Android version. Height is set to 25dp in values-v19/dimens.xml (20~25dp is best) and 0dp in values/dimens.xml. See implementation on this page.
Use system fitsSystemWindows attribute. Set fitsSystemWindows to true on the root node of layout, and specify status bar color in code via ImmersionBar. See implementation on this page.
Use ImmersionBar fitsSystemWindows method. Specify fitsSystemWindows as true, and specify status bar color (otherwise transparent). See implementation on this page.

Similar to Method 1, add a View tag above title bar with height specified as 0dp, without needing Android version checks in dimens.xml. ImmersionBar will handle it via statusBarView method. See implementation on this page.

No need to add view space in xml for status bar. Key method is titleBar(binding.toolbar). Principle: dynamically set title bar height based on status bar height and top padding as status bar height. Title bar height in XML cannot be wrap_content.

No need to add view space in xml for status bar. Key method is titleBarMarginTop(binding.toolbar). Principle: dynamically set title bar height based on status bar height and top marginTop as status bar height, then specify status bar color!

Regarding the issue where Snackbar height is inaccurate on 4.4 and EMUI 3.1, it is caused by system WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_TRANSLUCENT_STATUS or FLAG_TRANSLUCENT_NAVIGATION flags used by immersion.

A: For status bar, key method is statusBarDarkFont(true, 0.2f). Principle: If status bar font color change is supported, font becomes black; if unsupported, alpha is added to status bar.\nFor navigation bar, key method is navigationBarDarkIcon(true, 0.2f). Principle: If navigation bar icon color change is supported, icon becomes black; if unsupported, alpha is added to navigation bar.

To use immersion with Fragmentation framework, it is recommended to initialize immersion in the host Activity. To fix layout overlap, use Method 4 or 5 from readme (refer to BaseFiveFragment.onViewCreated). If using fitsSystemWindows(true), transition between fragments in single-Activity multi-Fragment setup will be less smooth. For individual fragment immersion, implement in onSupportVisible.
